name: My Moms Curse
overview: Husna, a resilient single mother, remarries her old love, Hadith, but faces rejection and tyranny from her mother-in-law, Che Yam. In cahoots with Hadith's younger sister, Syafiqah, Che Yam uses sorcery and slander to destroy Husna's life. Despite being persecuted, Husna remains loyal and lovingly cares for her paralyzed father-in-law. As the slander escalates, Hadith begins to doubt her loyalty, forcing Husna to leave. With the support of her friends and Nurul Iman, Husna rises again — and the truth about Che Yam and Syafiqah's evil plans is finally revealed.
